interface.shortDescription: Evidence-gated market research: social trend discovery and SEO/keyword-data methodology.
interface.longDescription: Research and data-analysis methodology for market/growth decisions. Currently includes trend-radar: discovers genuinely trending topics and keywords across Reddit, X/Twitter, TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram for a given niche, bottom-up (start from what's actually trending, never from a hypothesis), with per-platform engagement thresholds so every candidate is backed by a real, linkable, high-engagement post. More research/SEO-data methodology skills to follow under the same plugin.
defaultPrompt: Find what's actually trending right now for [niche] across Reddit and X.
Discover hot keywords for my SEO content plan, bottom-up, with evidence.
